title: Desenvolvedor full stack(Go e Java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel

Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.

Visão geral do cargo

Estamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou pleno para projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.

O que você fará

• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).

• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.

• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).

• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.

• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.

• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.

Requisitos mandatorios:

• Sólida experiência com Golang.

• Experiência com Java 8+.

• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).

• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).

• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.

• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.

Diferenciais

• Experiencia com framework quarkus.

• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).

• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.

• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

If you’re someone who thrives in neurology studies and enjoys working on impactful research, this could be a great fit for you.

This sponsor truly values quality and consistency, and you’d be joining a talented team dedicated to advancing care for patients with seizure disorders.


The application window is short , so if this sounds like something you’d like to explore, let’s set up a quick chat today!

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

title: Analista de suporte e implantação de software
description:
Estamos contratando: Suporte / Implantador de Sistema Hablla


Você é apaixonado(a) por automação, integrações e criação de fluxos inteligentes? Já trabalhou com n8n, Make ou Zapier e adora transformar complexidade em simplicidade?


Então essa vaga é para você


Na Hablla, somos pioneiros em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI), metodologia que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Performance em uma única plataforma conversacional. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas B2B a crescerem de forma integrada, inteligente e escalável.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Implantar e configurar fluxos diretamente na plataforma Hablla, utilizando toda sua experiência prévia em automações.

Criar integrações via APIs REST e requisições HTTP, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance.

Manipular e transformar JSON em diferentes cenários de integração.

Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos clientes.

Customizar cadências e jornadas de atendimento alinhadas à nossa metodologia MCI.

Colaborar com os times de Customer Success e Produto, trazendo insights para evolução contínua da plataforma.


O que esperamos de você


Experiência prática com plataformas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier ou similares).

Conhecimento sólido em requisições HTTP e consumo de APIs REST.

Domínio em JSON para manipulação de dados.

Capacidade de diagnóstico e solução de problemas em integrações.

Boa comunicação, clareza e organização no dia a dia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:


Noções de Node.js ou javascript.

Conhecimento de Webhooks e mensageria em tempo real.

Vivência em implantação de SaaS B2B, CRM ou soluções Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos


Contrato PJ

R$ 4.500,00 nos 3 primeiros meses (período de experiência)

Após experiência: R$ 6.000,00 mensais

Oportunidade de crescer em uma startup inovadora, referência em tecnologia e Marketing Conversacional.


Se você se identificou, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando a forma como negócios se comunicam, envie seu perfil e venha construir o futuro da comunicação com a gente!

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margens e projeções comerciais.

Compreender processos de injeção de alumínio (alta pressão).
Interpretar desenhos, projetos e necessidades de células de produção.
Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.

Formação
Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência
Vivência no setor de injeção de alumínio (HPDC) ou fundição.
Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)

Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico.
Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.

Comunicação consultiva.
Negociação e relacionamento.
Organização e gestão de pipeline.
Autonomia para visitas e viagens.

Remuneração fixa + variável agressiva por performance.

Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.
Crescimento estruturado dentro do ecossistema LoopGlobal.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

ID:

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

ID:

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) Pleno - Afirmativa PCD
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: 海外销售经理-饲料/动物营养方向
description:
Key Responsibilities：

  • Comply and implement the company's processes and systems.
  • Sales Plan Execution: Execute the business strategy and annual plan developed by the department, focus on business opportunities and organize resources to achieve annual sales budget and profit budget.
  • Market development: according to the department's business development strategy and sales objectives, cooperate with relevant departments to organize and implement the regional market development plan and specific implementation plan, and promote the promotion of the company and product brand. Understand the dynamics of customer needs, tap potential customers, and track customer development to achieve continuous growth in the company's market share.
  • Customer relationship maintenance: according to the needs of the department's business development, establish smooth customer communication channels by organizing and arranging customers to visit the company, visiting and communicating. Responsible for visiting important customers in the region, keep abreast of customer requirements, handle customer objections and complaints in a timely manner to improve customer satisfaction and establish long-term, good and stable customer relationships.
  • Customer service: According to the company's customer service regulations and product characteristics, through communication with technical support, research and development, production and other relevant departments, coordinate product trial, technical support and other work to improve customer satisfaction with products and company services.
  • Sales expense control: comply with the company's sales expense management regulations and the sales department's expense budget indicators to control sales expenses.
  • Collaborative communication: Establish necessary cross-departmental business contacts and communication to ensure timely information sharing and delivery.
  • Others: Complete temporary important tasks assigned by superiors.

Qualifications：

  • At least BSc. in Biochemical or Bioengineering or any relevant fields with minimum 5 years working experience in enzyme industry.
  • Master the basic knowledge of all products and services of the company and understand the company's operation mode.
  • Good sales etiquette, able to better grasp the customer's psychology, understand and can effectively use sales skills.
  • Able to think from the customer's point of view, strong sales ability.
  • Good communication and coordination skills, calm, initiative and responsible.
  • High work enthusiasm, good team work spirit.
  • Strong ability to resist pressure and learning ability
